other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh.
The applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker.
The applicant must have completed at least 90 days of building or other construction work in the last 12 months.
Registration must be renewed annually and the membership with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB) must be active at the time of application.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹50,000 annually for outdoor treatment, ₹1,00,000 for indoor medical expenses, and ₹5,00,000 for critical illnesses per year to registered beneficiaries and their dependents.
documents_required: Labour Welfare Office application form (hard copy)
Wage slip or appointment letter verifying 90 days of construction work
Certificate from a local authority (councillor, executive officer, or Panchayat Secretary) if wage slip is unavailable
